questions.prompt: Greet the partner, correct their mistaken identification of you, and identify the man beside you with the familiar name.
questions.context:
A new partner guesses that you are Xiaowang. You are not Xiaowang; the man standing beside you is Xiaowang. Greet the partner, correct the mistaken identification and identify that man with the familiar name.
Familiar meanings available: hello; hi; I; me; be; person; people; not; familiar address for a younger person surnamed Wang; be called; call or name someone; ask someone to act.
